content: write me a simple discord.py bot

Certainly! Here is a simple Discord bot written using the discord.py library:
```
import discord

client = discord.Client()

@client.event
async def on_ready():
    print('Logged in as {0.user}'.format(client))

@client.event
async def on_message(message):
    if message.author == client.user:
        return

    if message.content.startswith('!hello'):
        await message.channel.send('Hello!')

client.run('YOUR_DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN_HERE')
```
This bot will log in to Discord using the token provided, and then listen for messages in a channel. If a message starts with the text '!hello', the bot will respond with 'Hello!'.

You can customize this bot by adding more event handlers and commands, or by modifying the existing code. For example, you could add a command to send a message to a specific channel, or to add a role to a user. The discord.py library has many useful features for building Discord bots, so I encourage you to explore the documentation and see what you can create!
